name: Border Patrol
description:
Here, the people of Ursus kindled the flames of their civilization, hoping to drive back what they saw as beasts.
<Static Roadblock>Blocks the advance of Talulah, the Fighter, and Ursus Civilians; Can be destroyed
<Ursus Civilian>Depletes Life Points when killed by an enemy.
<Heat Pump Passage>Periodically deals great damage to any units on it.
